title: The difference between a viral video and an ignored one often comes down to a single click.
description:
That click is usually earned by the thumbnail.

The best creators don't just invest time in making better videos—they invest time in making people want to watch them. A compelling thumbnail can dramatically improve your video's first impression and give great content the attention it deserves.

Creating content is only half the job.

Getting people to click is the other half.
